sloka: पादच्छायामुपागम्य सुखमस्य महात्मनः ।उपवासपरैकाग्रा वस त्वं जनकात्मजे ।। ७.४७.१७ ॥
transliteration: pādacchāyāmupāgamya sukhamasya mahātmanaḥ ।upavāsaparaikāgrā vasa tvaṁ janakātmaje ।। 7.47.17 ॥

translations.english: O daughter of Janaka, you should dwell happily and with focused devotion to fasting in the shade of this great soul (Valmiki).
